title: Pathfinder
text:
Pathfinder is an Ascendancy class for the Ranger.


== Overview ==
The Pathfinder is a survival specialist with a focus in flasks, mobility, and flexibility with the passive skill tree.  Enduring Elixirs allows her life flasks to continue recovering her life even after recovering to full, and she can learn one of five Concoction skills to turn her mana flask into a source of damage. Relentless Pursuit and Running Assault keeps her mobile by mitigating effects that can reduce her movement speed or stop her entirely. The Pathfinder can gain a second starting point on the passive skill tree with Path Seeker and gain additional choices of stat bonuses on the travel nodes from Traveller's Wisdom. Other passives include Overwhelming Toxicity to double the number of poison stacks, and Sustainable Practices to gain elemental damage reduction from evasion.
